title: Member Tenure Rates on Northgate Tire Center Rotation Charges
content:
# Member tenure rates on rotation charges

**Schedule.** A Northgate Tire Center rotation charge carries a member rate read from the Northgate Memberships record of the membership whose card was presented on the tires' purchase, its tenure being the whole calendar months from that membership's opened date to the service date of the rotation entry (the most recent rotation entry recorded on the package). A month counts once its day of the month is reached.

| Membership presented on the tires' purchase | Tenure | Member rate |
|---|---|---|
| Plus tier | at least 60 months | 0.6 |
| not a Plus tier, business segment | at least 60 months | 0.8 |
| any other membership | — | 1 — the full rate |

A membership is a Plus tier when it carries a Plus premium above zero. "Any other membership" includes a Plus tier or a business-segment membership with fewer than 60 months of tenure, and every membership that is neither a Plus tier nor in the business segment.

**How the rate acts.** The rotation charge is multiplied by the member rate. The rate acts on the unrounded charge, and the charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Boundary of the 60-month tenure (hypothetical dates)

| Membership opened | Rotation entry dated | Whole months | Plus tier rate | Business-segment, non-Plus rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2021-03-15 | 2026-03-15 | 60 | 0.6 | 0.8 |
| 2021-03-15 | 2026-03-14 | 59 | 1 | 1 |

A $40.00 rotation charge before this rate becomes $24.00 at 0.6 and $32.00 at 0.8.
